attempted_implication: A genuinely varying algebraic-witness source should cover the target Hodge branch once its actual image, rather than its source tangent, is controlled.
exact_mathematical_result: For one reduced irreducible Hodge-locus germ H, a closed reduced same-class witness-image germ L contained in H with dim(L)=dim(H) equals H as a reduced germ.
diagnosis: After C004 removes source-tangent dimension as a faithful progress measure, the first local completeness discriminator can be moved to the geometry of the image itself: exact class binding + closed image + target-component irreducibility + top-dimensionality are sufficient for reduced set-theoretic coverage.
strongest_supported_cause: Irreducibility plus the strict dimension drop for proper closed subsets; the certificate succeeds because it controls the root consumer image directly rather than inferring it from source coordinates.
competing_causes_or_boundaries: without closedness, a proper dense subset can have full dimension
without component binding, one top-dimensional component can miss another
without exact-class binding, domination can concern the wrong cohomology class
reduced-germ equality leaves nilpotents/formal neighborhoods uncontrolled
monodromy requires a local marking/trivialization before 'same alpha' is meaningful
falsifier: Produce a proper closed reduced subgerm L of a reduced irreducible germ H with dim_s L = dim_s H, or an admissible same-class source satisfying all stated hypotheses whose reduced image germ fails to equal H.
repair_or_next_discriminator: Construct a source-specific coupled signed-Q incidence and prove exact class identity, closedness/properness and top-dimensional reduced image for each target Hodge component; do not return to source-tangent-size arguments.
evidence: Kloosterman arXiv:2104.14845 as special-family positive image-coverage calibration
Cattani-Deligne-Kaplan arXiv:alg-geom/9402009 as Hodge-locus geometric target control

linked_prior_process_failures.reason: C004 showed that source tangent enlargement may be vertical; C005 repairs routing by testing the actual closed image germ
prevents interpreting total-class persistence as componentwise persistence when constructing a signed-Q source
